text:
maria-g: Heads-up — Acme sent over a customer security questionnaire and requested a live review call tomorrow 09:00 PT. Main asks: KMS/HSM integration options, RBAC mapping to their IdP groups, and detailed audit log retention and export. Can @ajay-patel or @olivia-w join?
ajay-patel: I can take the KMS/HSM part. Quick Q — they specifically asked for HSM attestation (FIPS 140-2) and cross-account CMKs. We support BYOK with dedicated keys in our KMS integration, but attestation docs are in the private compliance repo.
olivia-w: I’ll handle RBAC + audit logging. Need to confirm whether we expose per-API-key audit trails or only account-level. I think we have token-level tracing but need to check retention windows.
david-l: Re: cross-account CMKs, we have an internal pattern (INF-2345) to create a CustomerKey resource mapped to org-id; owner can give us a grant to use. We should prepare a one-pager.
maria-g: Copy. Also they asked about reassignable roles vs. static service roles — they want IdP->Redwood role mapping so they can manage team leads. Any gaps?
ajay-patel: We map SAML groups to platform roles via SCIM; currently SCIM is available for Dedicated and Private customers. For Hosted customers, we offer SSO with mapped claims but not full SCIM provisioning — call that out.
security-oncall: FYI: last month we added an audit export endpoint to push JSON logs to a customer S3/GCS via signed URL (SEC-789). Retention is 90 days by default, can extend with enterprise retention add-on.
olivia-w: For the questionnaire item about immutable audit logs + tamper evidence — we can provide signed log digests that are SHA256 over batches and rotated daily. Need input from infra team on rotation TTL.
incidents-bot: Incident INC-2026: routine key rotation completed for prod, no impact. Logged for context.
maria-g: For the call, they also want to discuss vuln triage timelines when critical CVEs hit a model runtime. We have SLA for critical patching in Dedicated/private within 48 hours and hosted escalations — correct?
ajay-patel: Hosted: we typically mitigate via autoswap to fallback model for <24h while patch is applied. For runtime CVEs we follow the Roadmap Patch Playbook (link: https://redwood.internal/patch-playbook). Will paste the relevant excerpt in thread.
odified-dev-snippet: ```
# example grant policy for cross-account CMK
{
  "Version": "2012-10-17",
  "Statement": [
    {"Effect":"Allow","Principal":{"AWS":"arn:aws:iam::123456789012:role/RedwoodService"},"Action":["kms:Decrypt","kms:Encrypt"],"Resource":"*"}
  ]
}
```
maria-g: Nice. Olivia — can you confirm whether the token-level traces include prompt/response hashes or full text? Customer said they need "prompt lineage" for audit.
olivia-w: We store request metadata + token counts and can optionally store deltas (hashed or encrypted payload) depending on retention policy. Full PII/data redaction is available via redaction pipeline (opt-in) — that removes raw prompt text and preserves a hash.
david-l: Action items: 1) Ajay: assemble HSM attestation docs + BYOK cross-account flow (ticket SEC-802). 2) Olivia: confirm audit export sample and prompt-lineage options (ticket SEC-803). 3) Maria: schedule call and prepare one-pager for RBAC mapping differences between Hosted/Dedicated/Private.
maria-g: Call scheduled: 1763544000 (tomorrow 09:00 PT). Invite sent to Acme security leads.
ajay-patel: I'll bring sample KMS policy and HSM attestation note.
olivia-w: I'll bring sample audit export JSON and example retention contract language.
security-oncall: If they push for on-prem key material handshake, flag to infra—HSM handoffs require SOC2 process + legal addendum.
maria-g: Good catch — add that to the agenda. Anything else?
ajay-patel: Minor: clarify our support for customer-managed rotation vs Redwood-managed rotation. Some customers need rotation logs in audit. We provide rotation events in audit stream.
olivia-w: Also prepare a short demo: enable audit export -> ingest into their SIEM via sample LQL. Keeps the call concrete.
maria-g: Perfect. I’ll drop the questionnaire link and a pared-down FAQ before the call. Thanks all. :thumbsup:
incidents-bot: Note: scheduled maintenance window WN-44 next week — potential networking changes in dedicated regions. Keep on checklist for Private deployment conversations.
